# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 98 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 98 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_098_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9 — Hermas Himself Is One of These Stones

**1** "And the spotted stones?" I asked. **2** "These are people who believe," he said, "and for the most part their faith is genuine — but they also have a foot in worldly wealth. **3** When hardship comes, their money and business dealings cause them to turn their back on the Lord." **4** "So when will they qualify for the tower?" **5** "When the wealth that keeps drawing their souls astray gets stripped away from them. **6** But if they repent first, they can qualify. Just as a round stone can only become square when it is cut and something is removed — the wealthy can only become fit for the Lord when something is taken from their riches." **7** "And here's something you should understand about yourself: when you were wealthy, you were useless to God. Now that you've been brought low — now you're genuinely useful and productive for the life of God. Be useful to God! And know this: you yourself were taken from these very same stones." **8** "And the other spotted stones — the ones with white spots?" **9** "These are people who abandoned God, blasphemed, and became informers against other believers. **10** For them there is no repentance — only death. That is why they are black: they belong to the realm of death." **11** "And those who returned half-withered cracked branches?" **12** "These were people who always got along with each other and held no grudges. They genuinely lit up when they saw each other. **13** That's why their stones were partially pulled from the tower — but because of their love for each other and their harmony, they were put back."

---

*PNEUMA renders Hermas's personal address (v. 7) with maximum pastoral impact, and renders "betrayers" as "informers" — possibly reflecting the Roman legal context of denouncing Christians.*
